description: Files under templates/<folder> are rendered to the same path in the target repo. A trailing .tmpl is dropped (so Git, npm, and editors do not read the file as real config in the central repo). Files not listed here are fully managed (full).

vendor.why: Check scripts and their libraries are copied as they are so sub-repos can run the checks without the central repo. No template variables are substituted.

data.why: Data read by the sync script, so it is not copied to target repos as a file. labels.json is applied as the issue labels of the target repo (#40).

mirror.why: Claude Code reads only .claude/skills/. A copy with the same content as the source skills/ is managed too.

dependencyFields.why: The versions.json dependencies (external dependencies shared by the 8 apps and the scaffold) are written into managed fields of the 3 app package.json files. Versions are raised centrally and spread through sync PRs; standards-check catches an app that differs (#304).
